remarks: Move-In Ready End Unit! Welcome home to this bright and inviting end-unit condominium featuring a private entrance and a desirable location close to everything Norwalk has to offer. The well-appointed kitchen provides ample cabinet space, while the open-concept living and dining area is filled with natural light and features a sliding glass door leading to your private deck-perfect for relaxing or entertaining. The first floor also offers beautiful hardwood floors throughout and a convenient half bath. Upstairs, you'll find two generously sized bedrooms with excellent closet space and a full bath. Additional features include a dedicated storage unit, as well as heat and hot water included in the common charges for added value and convenience. Set among beautifully maintained, park-like grounds, this home offers a peaceful setting while being ideally located near major highways, shopping, dining, train stations, and commuting routes.Don't miss this exceptional opportunity to own a move-in-ready home in a sought-after location!
